usage: Use 兩個 (loeng5 go3) when counting individual fruits or vegetables.
Always put the measure word 個 (go3) after the number 兩 (loeng5).
兩個 can refer to pieces, like fruits or small vegetables.
It’s common to hear 兩個 in markets when buying food items.
Use 兩個 to specify exact quantity in everyday conversations.
